purpose: BTC longest available history: date-correct original CoinMetrics BTC, Fed H4.1 releases, as-of FRED NFCI and ANFCI; compare strong upside AND strong downside, no need for modern alt basket
population: ALL eligible v8.9 Sundays as far back as source permits, not just NON-EXPANSION, with complete 52wk future CoinMetrics BTC fixing until 2026-10-17, FRED NFCI+ANFCI true 4wk as-of vintage feature and valid 5 official Fed releases. Also separate non-expansion BTC subset. 2010 BTC price daily exists, 2011 earliest weekly indicators after 34 weeks; no 2010 macro backfill.
fedRule: H4.1 assets minus TGA minus consolidated RRP four release delta >0, cutoff Sunday-3 days; five reports <=10d apart, no genuinely missing report within five release window.
financeRule: NFCI and ANFCI as-of Sunday request with each last obs 6-18d stale and 5 weekly observations spanning 27-35 calendar days. Delta4<0 easing, >0 tightening, flat neutral. Both Chicago measures only one independent family.

models.STRICT_ALL: A AND F AND N AND J
models.NEG_MACRO: Fed delta4<0 AND NFCI delta4>0 AND ANFCI delta4>0

outcomes.UP13: within next 13 Sundays maximum BTC weekly close >=+20% vs start
outcomes.UP26: within next 26 Sundays maximum BTC weekly close >=+50% vs start
outcomes.UP52: within next 52 Sundays maximum BTC weekly close >=+100% vs start
outcomes.DOWN13: within next 13 weeks minimum BTC DAILY close <=-20% vs start
outcomes.DOWN26: within next 26 weeks minimum BTC DAILY close <=-35% vs start
outcomes.DOWN52: within next 52 weeks minimum BTC DAILY close <=-50% vs start

metrics: Exact same cohort baseline prevalence and TP FP FN TN, selection counts, medians and risks, split 2012, 2013-16, 2017-19, 2020-23, 2024-25; 14wk and 27wk alert lockout first signals; dates of false bullish alarms preceding falls and missed strong up moves, without cherry-picking.
source: R2 three SHA-pin prior parent objects, asof FRED exact requested Sunday raw historical vintages archived including response bytes base64+SHA and lag checks, R2 manifest and readback. No refresh to current FRED series. Output unknown for failed sources, no fabrication.
logic: Research is hindsight exploratory, past history heavily viewed and groups dependent; no significance/OOS/proven trading benefit; CoinMetrics PriceUSD is not executable. Market future horizon may be right-censored and must be excluded; no 52wk outcome for late 2026.
